name: keypad
title: Keypad
description: The keys of a phone, for a code or an amount typed with a thumb.
use: A passcode, a PIN or an amount entered on a touch screen, where the keyboard of the system would cover the page or offer too much. Each key is a button: the page puts its figure into an OTP field, an input or a total. Keep a real field on the page as well, so a hardware keyboard and a password manager still work.

instead.when: The code is typed with the system keyboard
A small count is stepped by one
Any other number or text is typed

classes.name: keypad
classes.description: The pad: keys in three columns, 8px apart, 17rem wide at most. It never selects its figures and never zooms on a double tap

classes.name: keypad-key
classes.description: One key, on a button: a raised face 52px tall with a large figure, which sinks at once under a press

classes.name: keypad-key-quiet
classes.description: A key that is not a figure, such as delete or a decimal point: no face until it is pressed

classes.name: keypad-letters
classes.description: The letters under a figure, small and quiet

states.name: disabled
states.description: The key is a flat well and cannot be pressed
